name: @packages/fixture-residue
description: The fixture-residue CONVENTION: the `.test-fixtures` directory name, the `<label>--<host>--<pid>--<random>` ownership-token format, owner liveness, entry classification, the sweep itself, and its rendering. Shared by the component that MINTS conforming directories (@packages/effect-bun-test/fixture-root) and any tooling plane that INSPECTS them and enforces that none outlives its suite. Zero runtime dependencies, node builtins only, so a compiled tooling binary can depend on it without dragging in a test harness.
